name: Maasai Mara Signature Safari
imageAlt: Safari travellers watching elephants in the Maasai Mara
summary: Big-cat country, golden plains and unhurried game drives with trusted local guides.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to the Mara
itinerary.description: Meet your Tembo host in Nairobi and drive through the Great Rift Valley to the Maasai Mara. Settle into camp before an introductory evening game drive.

itinerary.title: Big cats and open plains
itinerary.description: Spend a full day following the Mara's wildlife rhythms with picnic lunch in the reserve and time at key river crossings.

itinerary.title: Conservation and community
itinerary.description: Begin with a sunrise drive, then visit a community-led conservancy project before a relaxed evening around camp.

itinerary.title: Your Mara, your pace
itinerary.description: Choose a full-day drive or split morning and evening drives. An optional balloon safari can be arranged in advance.

itinerary.title: Return to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Enjoy a final bush breakfast, check out and return to Nairobi with a scenic lunch stop en route.

name: Amboseli Elephant Trails
imageAlt: A herd of African elephants crossing open Kenyan savannah
summary: Meet Amboseli's elephant families beneath wide skies and Kilimanjaro views.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Amboseli
itinerary.description: Depart Nairobi after breakfast for Amboseli. Arrive for lunch and take your first afternoon game drive across the wetlands.

itinerary.title: Elephant country
itinerary.description: Explore the park from sunrise, looking for its celebrated elephant families, lion, cheetah and abundant birdlife.

itinerary.title: Kilimanjaro morning
itinerary.description: Photograph Kilimanjaro in the cool morning light, visit Observation Hill and enjoy a slow afternoon at the lodge.

itinerary.title: Bush breakfast and home
itinerary.description: Take a short final drive and bush breakfast before returning to Nairobi in the afternoon.

name: Zanzibar Spice & Sea
imageAlt: A traveller walking along a white sand Zanzibar beach
summary: Stone Town stories, spice-farm aromas and barefoot days beside the Indian Ocean.

itinerary.title: Karibu Zanzibar
itinerary.description: Airport or ferry pickup and private transfer to Stone Town. Meet your local host over a rooftop welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Stone Town and spices
itinerary.description: Walk the lanes of Stone Town with a resident guide, then explore a working spice farm and taste island produce.

itinerary.title: To the beach
itinerary.description: Transfer to the coast with a relaxed afternoon for swimming and sunset dhow views.

itinerary.title: Ocean day
itinerary.description: Enjoy a guided snorkelling excursion with a fresh Swahili lunch, subject to sea conditions.

itinerary.title: A day of your own
itinerary.description: Choose complete beach time or add an optional Jozani Forest, village, or sailing experience.

itinerary.title: Island farewell
itinerary.description: Breakfast at leisure followed by your private transfer to the airport or ferry terminal.

inclusions: Two hosted lunches and welcome dinner

name: Uganda Gorilla Encounter
imageAlt: Mountain gorilla resting in dense green forest vegetation
summary: A carefully paced journey into Bwindi for one unforgettable hour with mountain gorillas.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Entebbe
itinerary.description: Meet your Tembo representative, settle into your hotel and receive a full trek briefing.

itinerary.title: Journey to Bwindi
itinerary.description: Fly or drive southwest through Uganda's highlands to your forest lodge near Bwindi.

itinerary.title: Gorilla trekking day
itinerary.description: Join Uganda Wildlife Authority rangers for your gorilla trek. Spend up to one hour with a habituated family before returning to the lodge.

itinerary.title: Return to Entebbe
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast overlooking the forest and transfer back to Entebbe for onward travel.

name: Serengeti Sky & Savanna
imageAlt: Hot-air balloons floating over East African savannah at sunrise
summary: A fly-in safari pairing private game drives with a sunrise balloon flight over the Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Arusha welcome
itinerary.description: Private airport welcome and overnight in Arusha with a personal safari briefing.

itinerary.title: Fly into the Serengeti
itinerary.description: Take a scenic bush flight to the Serengeti and begin your private game drive on arrival.

itinerary.title: Following the herds
itinerary.description: A flexible full-day game drive shaped around seasonal wildlife movement and your interests.

itinerary.title: Balloon morning
itinerary.description: Float over the plains at sunrise, land for a bush breakfast and return to camp for a restful afternoon.

itinerary.title: Private safari day
itinerary.description: Explore quieter areas with your guide, stopping for a picnic in the wilderness.

itinerary.title: Slow safari
itinerary.description: Choose another drive or enjoy the camp, guided nature interpretation and a special farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Bush flight to Arusha
itinerary.description: Transfer to the airstrip for your return flight and onward airport connection.

name: Diani Family Escape
imageAlt: Aerial view of Kenya's white sand coast and ocean
summary: An easy coastal escape with flexible family time, Swahili flavours and a marine adventure.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to the coast
itinerary.description: Travel by SGR or flight and meet your private transfer to Diani Beach. Settle in with a relaxed evening.

itinerary.title: Beach at your pace
itinerary.description: A free family day for the pool, white sand and optional water sports.

itinerary.title: Marine safari
itinerary.description: Join a guided ocean excursion with snorkelling, marine-life interpretation and a coastal lunch.

itinerary.title: Swahili coast stories
itinerary.description: Choose a local cultural experience or keep the day completely unplanned.

itinerary.title: Homeward
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and a final swim before your transfer for the return to Nairobi.

name: Nairobi Wildlife Day
imageAlt: Safari vehicle among acacia trees in warm morning light
summary: A full day pairing Nairobi National Park wildlife with conservation stories close to the city.

itinerary.title: Nairobi's wild side
itinerary.description: Begin with an early pickup and game drive in Nairobi National Park. Break for lunch, continue to the Giraffe Centre, and return to your Nairobi hotel by early evening.
